verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Chargebee sandbox or test site that is isolated from production data. The API Explorer (docs-9) makes live API calls, so it is not a sandbox. The community comment about a 'live site' and routing webhooks to dev and staging describes the user's own environment setup, not a documented sandbox capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
